opening_message:
Ticket 1: Alyssa Rose (employee ID E026) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 6 note(s) about employee E026.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Alyssa Rose (E026) is a full-time Analyst. Requested write access to Payroll. As full-time employee, max is write (role does not own Payroll, so no admin). Grant write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by IT agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: IT database confirms E026 (Alyssa Rose) is an Analyst. Full-time employee, max access is write (Analyst does not own Payroll, so no admin). Requested write, which is at max level. Recommend write.
Note 3 (ticket 1), written by Finance agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Finance database confirms E026 (Alyssa Rose) is an Analyst. Full-time employee, so max access to Payroll is write (Analyst does not own Payroll, so no admin). Requested write, which is at max. Recommend write.
Note 4 (ticket 1), written by Compliance agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Compliance database confirms E026 (Alyssa Rose) is an Analyst. Full-time employee. Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist; Analyst does not own Payroll, so max access is write (no admin). Requested write is at max. Recommend write.
Note 5 (ticket 1), written by Facilities agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Facilities database confirms E026 (Alyssa Rose) is an Analyst. Full-time employee. Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist; Analyst does not own Payroll, so max access is write (no admin). Requested write is at max. Recommend write.
Note 6 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security database shows E026 (Alyssa Rose) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors max is read, or write only with advanced training (never admin). Basic training means max is read. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: The Security agent verified in its own database that E026 (Alyssa Rose) is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractor employees may have at most read access (write only with advanced security training, never admin). The requested write exceeds this maximum, so the maximum allowed level, read, is granted. (The other agents' full_time claim was mostly copied from HR without independent verification, and Security's verified contractor status governs.)
